title: FLA import: fix bad class tag 0x204 parse error in symbol streams
description: flash8-import.ts warns 'could not parse symbol stream Symbol 1: Error: bad class tag 0x204 @ 0x6c3 — importing as empty symbol'. Class tag 0x204 = 0x0200 | 0x04 — this looks like a backref with combined index 4, but the parser is rejecting it. Investigate: (1) is 0x204 a valid MFC CArchive backref that the parser isn't handling? The combined table allocates TWO slots per class, so backref index 4 would refer to slot 4 in the combined table. (2) Is this a version-gated field being read on the wrong schema version? Fix the parser to handle this tag correctly. Evidence: the user hit this on a real FLA being imported.
